products.title: Special Edition Medusa Cameo
products.body_html:
History's most recognizable protective symbol, rendered in the world's most time-honored jewelry tradition. Since Ancient Greece, cameos have been hand-carved from precious stones, revealing public figures or mythic monsters in the reliefs. As a decorative element on shields or architectural carvings, Medusa's furious face was believed to ward off misfortune. Reimagined with a Victorian "openwork" halo of serpents, her power is not just protective but instructive: a reminder that your ferocity is not something to apologize for. It may be the source of your power.

For each piece sold, $10 will be donated to a support survivors of sexual violence through our partnerships with leading organizations in this space.

products.body_html: One of the world's most enduring symbols of eternal life, the ouroboros has been worn for protection for thousands of years. Like the snake, your own story is one of continual rebirth. Wear these petite ouroboros studs, each cradling a white sapphire or garnet, to remind yourself of the many incarnations that live within you.

products.title: Twin Serpent Mourning Locket
products.body_html: Mourning jewelry for the fervently alive. Victorian women wore hairwork — elaborately woven locks of deceased lovers' hair — in vessels around their necks. Twin serpents surround the stone, symbolizing continual rebirth and offering protection. Tuck something precious inside to be viewed through the quartz, partially obscured as if from the other side of the veil.

products.title: Snake Wrap Earring
products.body_html:
Protective. Transformative. Enduring. The snake is one of the most ancient jewelry motifs known to history, and continues to transcend today for its rich symbolic power. Its iconography has long been favored by royalty, ranging from ancient Egypt to Victorian England. Drape the Snake Wrap Earring from your ear to invoke the snake's endless capacity to shed what no longer serves, and be reborn anew. Your own personal transformation awaits.

To wear your Snake Wrap Earring, start by hooking the bottom of the earring under the ear lobe, then gently nudge the top of the earring over the antitragus / intertragal notch (the lowermost point of the inside of your ear). Adjust slightly from side to side until it sits comfortably. To lock in place, insert the post through your earlobe piercing and secure with the post backing.
